name: Commerce OCI Checkout
description: Turns a Drupal Commerce store into an Open Catalog Interface (OCI) punch-out supplier for B2B procurement: a buyer's procurement/ERP system opens an authenticated session (/oci/logon, credential-authenticated via core user.auth), the buyer builds a cart isolated in the session, and on checkout the cart is POSTed back to the buyer's HOOK_URL as an OCI NEW_ITEM form (/oci-cart) with server-authoritative prices, instead of being paid on the store. Gated by the 'use commerce_oci_checkout' permission; no admin config form.
php_requirement: Inherited from Drupal core (10.1+/11 require PHP 8.1+); composer.json declares no explicit PHP constraint.
project_description:
Makes it possible to do OCI checkout on a commerce site.

 Open Catalog Interface (OCI) is one of the standard formats used by SAP Supplier Relationship Management, ORDIGES Purchase-to-Pay, Microsoft Dynamics AX and other ERP/Purchasing Systems when connecting to external punch-out catalogs. 

 
 Open Catalog Interface on Wikipedia 

 Widely used in European countries, this makes it possible for B2B sales through this standard, using Drupal Commerce as the supplier of the store, and the customers own procurement system as the purchase portal.
